ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Jupiter

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.
